propositions: Three independent near-duplicate implementations of detached rebar child spawning exist across push.py, enrich_drain.py, and compact_trigger.py, each repeating PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, cwd handling, and stdio discipline.
A defect (missing cwd parameter in Popen call) propagated across all three sites due to copy-paste imitation, demonstrating that duplicated spawn logic cannot be fixed once.

A single canonical spawn_detached helper must consolidate the three sites into one implementation while preserving each caller's distinct exception handling, environment construction, and logging behavior.
The spawn_detached helper must remain a stdlib-only leaf with no rebar imports and must re-raise exceptions, leaving exception handling to per-site callers.
A fourth independent site (gc_trigger.py) implemented the same pattern concurrently, confirming that consolidation is required to prevent continued duplication.
